# KOVA repository guidance

Follow `AGENTS.md` in this repository.

This is **a disabled legacy assistant and application migration source**. Do not promote it to the canonical KOVA frontend or backend. The canonical hub is `Kathrynhiggs21/Kova-ai-SYSTEM`; the canonical web application is `Kathrynhiggs21/kovaos-site` for `kovaos.com`. Repository roles are recorded in the hub's `kova_repos_config.json` and `docs/architecture/KOVA_REPOSITORY_MAP.md`.

Keep changes on a review branch, preserve useful migration sources, and run existing relevant checks. Keep operation no-code for the owner and preserve dyslexia-first accessibility. Never commit secrets, claim an unverified connection is live, duplicate canonical artifacts, or add blanket merge automation. Production domain, environment, deletion, and irreversible integration changes require the owner's final check.
